thread:
Marta S: Quick Q - I have a 6h layover at KEF next week. Worth sprinting into town for Be6jarins Beztu pylsur hot dog or should I grab fiskisfapa at the airport? Carry-on only, low fuss.
Liam: Hot dog for sure if you want iconic + fast. Add the crunchy onions and remoulade. :hotdog:
Noor: Agree with Liam. Fiskisfapa is cozy but needs seating/time. If you want a warm soup and chill, go soup.
Sanjay: If youf9re short on time, stick to the hot dog. If you have >2h buffer, Sun Voyager walk + hot dog.
Marta S: How long is the shuttle into town? Doneft want to risk missing the flight.
Liam: Flybus is ~45m each way from recollection, plus wait. Taxi is faster but pricier.
Noor: Pro tip: get a short-stay locker by Harpa if you want to drop a jacket. Saves schlepping.
Marta S: Any veg options at the stand? Friend is vegetarian.
Liam: They usually have a veggie sausage option (not the same but tasty). Also plenty of bakeries on Laugavegur.
OpsBot: Reminder: non-work chatter only. :party_parrot: 
Marta S: Thanks all. Hot dog + quick Sun Voyager if time. Will post snack pic in #snacks. :camera_with_flash:
Noor: Enjoy! Iceland coffee game is strong, grab a flat white if you can.
